notes.title: PATCH 1.1
notes.content: I AM AWARE OF THE PROBLEMS THAT EXIST AND OF THE RESTART PROBLEMS THAT ARE BEING EXPERIENCED, I AM WORKING HARD TO FIX AND PATCH ALL THE BUGS AND ERRORS OF THE GAME, IF YOU SUFFER FROM ANY BUGS DO NOT HESITATE TO ADD OR RESPOND TO THIS NEWS REPORTING THE BUGS. THANK YOU VERY MUCH FOR YOUR PATIENCE AND I AM SORRY FOR THE INCONVENIENCE.

notes.content:
